About HDFC Bank Ltd.

HDFC Bank Ltd. is one of India's leading private sector enterprises, operating in the Banking sector. The company was established in 1994, and is listed on both Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange (NSE) under the symbol HDFCBANK.

Business Verticals & Subsidiaries

HDFC Bank Ltd. operates across multiple industries through its key subsidiaries and verticals, such as:
  • HDFC Trustee Co. Ltd
  • HDFC Securities Ltd.
  • HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Ltd.
  • HDFC Life Insurance Company Ltd.
  • HDFC Asset Management Company Ltd.

HDFC Bank Ltd. Stock Market Performance

As of 23 Aug 2026, the company has a market capitalization of Rs.11,20,311.4 Cr, classifying it as a Large Cap stock. The company is a key component of multiple benchmark indices, including:
  • Nifty 50
  • Nifty 500
  • Nifty 100
  • Nifty 200
  • Nifty LargeMidcap 250

The Latest Details of HDFCBANK Earnings

In FY 2025-2026, HDFC Bank Ltd. reported its revenue at Rs.3,48,615.2 Cr, an increase of 4% compared to the previous financial year. The profit after tax or PAT increased by 8% compared to last year and stood at Rs.79,219.5 Cr. The EBITDA of HDFC Bank Ltd. was Rs.1,06,336.4 Cr in FY 2025-2026.
